newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-ALFONSO TO STAY AT BETIS UNTIL 2005.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ALFONSO TO STAY AT BETIS UNTIL 2005.

text.p: Spanish international striker Alfonso Perez has signed a new contract with Real Betis that will earn him an estimated 300 million pesetas ($2.1 million) a season until 2005.
"Betis is a great club, my idea is to end my career here," said Alfonso on Friday. Alfonso had been linked to several clubs including Barcelona and AC Milan.
Any team wanting to buy the forward will now have to pay Betis eight billion pesetas ($55.1 million) .
"Some of these clauses are a bit excessive," admitted Alfonso, who has scored 25 goals for Betis in their surprise championship challenge.
Alfonso started his career at Real Madrid, but saw it disrupted by injury and joined Betis on loan at the beginning of last season.
He was recalled to Real Madrid over the close season, only to be sold back to Betis a few weeks later.
